## General Transportation Announcements
- UMass Boston now offers free e-bike and e-scooter charging at the West Garage Secured Shelter with 13 Saris Power Posts; simply register your bike through Project 529 for Beaconcard access. Learn more about bike parking and facilities .

## Shuttle Bus Information
View our shuttle schedule, discover GPS tracking features, and explore advertising opportunities on our shuttle bus service.

## Shuttle Bus GPS Tracking

## Shuttle Bus Advertising
If you’d like to advertise on our university shuttle buses, please follow the guidelines below: File Design Paper Size & Orientation: Please design your file on 11x17-inch paper in landscape orientation. File Format: Save your design as a PDF. Design Assistance: If you need help with your design, please complete a request using the Creative Services Request Form . Printing Details Printing Information: All ads are printed by Quinn Graphics to meet the required specifications on the shuttles. Size & Format: 11x17 inches, landscape format. Material : Index stock with lamination. Quantity : Order 10–20 ads (this will cover 1–2 ads per shuttle bus). Order Instructions : Clearly indicate that it is a shuttle ad in the comments when placing your order. Delivery Address: Transportation Services, Service & Supply, Lower Level. Contact for Inquiries : For printing questions and cost estimates, email Quinn Graphics at Quinn.graphics@umb.edu . Placement Details Ad Requirements : Ads must comply with university policy and the student code of conduct. Review Process: Once received at our office, ads will be reviewed and forwarded to our shuttle contractor on the next available Friday. Installation Day : The contractor installs ads on Saturdays. Ad Duration: Ads for Events: Will be removed and recycled after the event date. Undated Ads : Will be removed and recycled on June 30 at the end of the current fiscal year. Further Inquiries For additional questions, please email us at TransDM@umb.edu . Thank you for your interest in advertising with us!
If you’d like to advertise on our university shuttle buses, please follow the guidelines below:
File Design
- Paper Size & Orientation: Please design your file on 11x17-inch paper in landscape orientation.
- File Format: Save your design as a PDF.
- Design Assistance: If you need help with your design, please complete a request using the Creative Services Request Form .
Printing Details
- Printing Information: All ads are printed by Quinn Graphics to meet the required specifications on the shuttles.
- Size & Format: 11x17 inches, landscape format.
- Material : Index stock with lamination.
- Quantity : Order 10–20 ads (this will cover 1–2 ads per shuttle bus).
- Order Instructions : Clearly indicate that it is a shuttle ad in the comments when placing your order.
- Delivery Address: Transportation Services, Service & Supply, Lower Level.
- Contact for Inquiries : For printing questions and cost estimates, email Quinn Graphics at Quinn.graphics@umb.edu .
Placement Details
- Ad Requirements : Ads must comply with university policy and the student code of conduct.
- Review Process: Once received at our office, ads will be reviewed and forwarded to our shuttle contractor on the next available Friday.
- Installation Day : The contractor installs ads on Saturdays.
Ad Duration:
- Ads for Events: Will be removed and recycled after the event date.
- Undated Ads : Will be removed and recycled on June 30 at the end of the current fiscal year.
Further Inquiries
For additional questions, please email us at TransDM@umb.edu .
Thank you for your interest in advertising with us!
